head: xrǧ (< Arab. xrǧ (IV) cf. Wehr 327: verlustig gehen lassen, berauben;)

senses.gloss: get accustomed to smth-in a bad sense, to smt bad )

stems.sensesRaw: 1) to finish (intr.) (2) get accustomed to smth-in a bad sense, to smt bad )

examples.translation: the fire wood of stove is over/has burned down.
examples.raw: 1)aq qayse di ṣoba xariǧi  the fire wood of stove is over/has burned down. (İshaq Arkaḥ p.c)

examples.translation: I am getting accustomed to this world.
examples.raw: 2)Ono koxoraǧno bi briṯaṯe. I am getting accustomed to this world. (İlyas p.c)
2)Ono xarǝǧno bu maḥyo. I got accustomed to beating. (İlyas p.c)

examples.turoyo: Ono xarǝǧno bu ḥamro; Ono xarǝǧno bu šuġlo.  Ono mxarǝǧno bi ḥṭiṯo, Ono xarǝǧno bad dugle (İlyas p.c)/ Ono xarǧo no bad dugle
examples.raw: Ono xarǝǧno bu ḥamro; Ono xarǝǧno bu šuġlo.  Ono mxarǝǧno bi ḥṭiṯo, Ono xarǝǧno bad dugle (İlyas p.c)/ Ono xarǧo no bad dugle

examples.turoyo: Panǝk alo iḏan mǝmlǝnwa kube hŭl d-mixarǧiwa.
examples.translation: Because of those ones, gosh, our hands were filled with thorns untill they were inured. (No 183: 2018_07_au_003_NE_1F.
examples.raw: Panǝk alo iḏan mǝmlǝnwa kube hŭl d-mixarǧiwa. Because of those ones, gosh, our hands were filled with thorns untill they were inured. (No 183: 2018_07_au_003_NE_1F.

notes: I:xarǝǧ/xorǝǧ                                                                                                                    1) to finish (intr.) (2) get accustomed to smth-in a bad sense, to smt bad )

detransitiveSenses.gloss: To be exhausted, to be used up completely,

stems.detransitiveSensesRaw: 1)To be exhausted, to be used up completely, 2)Verfehlen; 3) to get used

examples.translation: I was exhausted by a severe illness.
examples.raw: 1)Mxaraǧno bu kewo pis. I was exhausted by a severe illness.(İlyas p.c)

examples.translation: I have been exhausted (fucked up) in this country.
examples.raw: Mxaraǧno bi dawlaṯe. I have been exhausted (fucked up) in this country. (İlyas p.c)

examples.turoyo: mxarǧi aḥ ḥayayḏi bu ṭurano (meqǝm ruḥayye).
examples.translation: My life was spent (by itself, anticausative) in this mountainside.
examples.raw: mxarǧi aḥ ḥayayḏi bu ṭurano (meqǝm ruḥayye). My life was spent (by itself, anticausative) in this mountainside. (İlyas p.c.: pis yo)

examples.translation: My life has been spent in this city.
examples.raw: Mxarǧi aḥ ḥayayḏi bi walayaṯe. My life has been spent in this city. (İlyas p.c)

examples.translation: (wir wollten uns auf einer belebten Strasse treffen) und haben uns verfehlt
examples.raw: 2) mxarǧina me-ʕal ḥḏoḏe ʻ(wir wollten uns auf einer belebten Strasse treffen) und haben uns verfehltʼ; 222;(IT IS NOT CLEAR)
3) mxaraǧno bu+ḥappәs ‘I got used to prison’ (Ilyas.p.c.)

examples.turoyo: B̥anǝk, Ăḷo, iḏan mǝmlǝnwa kube hul dmixarǧiwa.
examples.translation: Because of those ones, gosh, our hands were filled with thorns untill they were inured.
examples.raw: B̥anǝk, Ăḷo, iḏan mǝmlǝnwa kube hul dmixarǧiwa. ‘Because of those ones, gosh, our hands were filled with thorns untill they were inured.’ (Nisane 2018-07-08)

notes: II: (There is no active diathesis in this stem)

examples.turoyo: Gmaxraǧno aḥ ḥayayḏi bu yǝlfono di ʕito.
examples.translation: I am going to spend all my life in the studying the church (tradition). İlyas p.c
examples.raw: 1)Gmaxraǧno aḥ ḥayayḏi bu yǝlfono di ʕito. I am going to spend all my life in the studying the church (tradition). İlyas p.c

examples.turoyo: Maxraǧli aḥ ḥayayḏi b ṭur abdin.
examples.translation: I spent my live in Tur abdin (no evaluation, no bad sense).
examples.raw: 1)Maxraǧli aḥ ḥayayḏi b ṭur abdin. I spent my live in Tur abdin (no evaluation, no bad sense).(İlyas p.c)
1)Adyawma maxraǧli mate waroqe.Today I spent 100 liras. (İlyas p.c)
2)Li dawlaṯe maxraǧlali.This country used me up. (İlyas p.c)

examples.turoyo: Li ḥurmaṯe maxraǧlali. Ono mtaxraǧno (mu gabo di ḥurmaṯe).  (İlyas p.c)
examples.translation: This woman used me up. I am used up (by this woman).
examples.note: = qtilali, matәmlali, bʕeǧlali, т. е. Она довела меня
examples.raw:
2)Li ḥurmaṯe maxraǧlali. Ono mtaxraǧno (mu gabo di ḥurmaṯe).  (İlyas p.c)

2)u kewo maxraǧleli. (İshaq Arkah p.c)

examples.turoyo: [Li ḥurmaṯe maxraǧlali]. Ono mtaxraǧno (mu gabo di ḥurmaṯe).  (İlyas p.c)
examples.translation: This woman used me up. I am used up (by this woman).
